result: If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it impossible for anyone to believe—with total certainty—that they are right about something for which they have no evidence. Not to silence disagreement, but to force humility. To make every person pause, question their own assumptions, and actually listen to someone they disagree with. The world’s worst harms almost always begin with unshakeable certainty. The cure isn’t doubt for its own sake—it’s the willingness to be wrong. That one change would unravel tribalism, propaganda, and the quiet cruelty that comes from treating other people as enemies instead of mysteries.
